what: NOTCH3 stays REQUIRED (the diagnosis is CADASIL) but is out of the stop rule.

check_drug_interactions now recommended and out of the stop rule (sumatriptan discontinuation stays a must). Class NOWAIT (14 cases that give IVT, P02 included): the IVT must now says to start it without waiting for CTA, ECG, troponin or labs other than glucose unless a coagulopathy, thrombocytopenia or anticoagulant exposure is suspected (AHA/ASA 2026). ECG, admission bloods and CTA stay required and in the stop rule: the benchmark has no clock between actions, so 'do not delay IVT' is expressed in the IVT must (class NOWAIT), not by removing the work-up the single final assessment needs.
